title: Behind the Memo: What Really Matters?
summary:
Most people
are not predicting growth for the next 10 years, which if you think about it, that's what really matters. Elroy Dimson characterized
risk brilliantly by saying risk means more things can happen than will happen. If there was only one, then there'd be no risk.
